settings.task: Periodic viscous Burgers: u0(x) -> u(x, t) on the space-time grid
settings.reference_solver: Fourier pseudo-spectral ETDRK4 (4x finer in x, dt <= 1e-3), subsampled
settings.error_metric: relative L2 over the full (nx, nt) grid against the reference solver
settings.residual_metric: RMS of u_t + u u_x - nu u_xx on the grid (spectral in x, 4th-order central differences in t, levels 3..nt-3)
